## Declarative file icons + clearer pin preview

Builds on **0.1.32**. Explorer / tabs / Quick Open / Recent use a **VS Code–compatible icon theme** (Material Icon Theme, MIT) instead of Lucide-only coloured glyphs, and the preview pin control uses **different icons** for pinned vs following.

### Declarative file icon theme
- Ships `icon-themes/material/` with `theme.json` + SVGs in the [VS Code file icon theme](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/extension-guides/file-icon-theme) shape (`iconDefinitions`, `fileExtensions`, `fileNames`, `folderNames`, …).
- PDF / Typst / Markdown and common languages get Material icons (pre-coloured), not look-alike Lucide shapes.
- **Swap a package:** drop another folder under `icon-themes/<name>/` with the same layout and point `DEFAULT_ICON_THEME` in `src/file_icon.rs` at it (Lucide remains the fallback when an id has no SVG).
- See `icon-themes/material/README.md`.
- **Lazy load:** `theme.json` is parsed once; SVG bytes load on first paint of that icon id and are cached (cap ~512). Opening Explorer does not decode the whole pack.

### Pin preview — distinct glyphs + editor fixed
- **Bugfix:** pinning used to mount every open document in *both* the editor and preview columns. The duplicate (invisible) editor ate focus — Ctrl+Z / shortcuts broke while pinned. Each document is mounted once again.
- Unpinned (live follow): **PinOff** icon + label “Follow” / “Following active — {file}”.
- Pinned: **Pin** icon + label “Pinned” / “Pinned: {file}”, stronger chrome, status bar “Pinned: {file}”.
- Same control still toggles; the two states do not share one glyph.

### Verify
- `cargo test file_icon`
- `cargo test pinned_preview_mounts`
- `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`
